name: live-rollback-derived
objective: v2.3 plan 04 (M3/M4, real turn): the boundary a gate fires on, carrying a delta an earlier message supplied, rolls the engine AND the memory stores back together when that message is edited — the ledger version that turn replaced comes back and the belief a reveal retired is un-retired, with the player told. The epistemic and ledger passes run with debug responses on purpose: the store reversal is what this proves, the parser has its own live suites. The edited message is the gate message (checkpointStartedMessageId), not the newest one: the onEnter opener of cp2 or a chained voice can land after it. When it is still the newest reply the edit re-read spike handles the edit (the D-EB1 path), otherwise the opener rollback or the plain rollback does; both must step back and tell the player. Every read but the scripted one is pinned to SCENE_NONE so a background read cannot re-propose the delta (v3.0 end batch).

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); rt.setEpistemicLedgerCapable(true); if (!rt.getSnapshot().memory.settings.epistemicLedgerCapable) throw new Error(`the epistemic/ledger capability did not stick`); return { capable: true };

send_generate.text: I get close to the job board and read the postings.

extract.debugResponse: DELTA q=approached_board value=true evidence="I get close to the job board"

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const state = rt.getEngineState(); const last = state.lastMessageId; const gate = state.checkpointStartedMessageId; const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length; if (gate < 2) throw new Error(`this check dates two passes by the gate message: gate=${gate} last=${last} of ${chat}`); globalThis.__gate = gate; return { gate, last, chat, path: gate === chat - 1 ? `edit re-read` : `rollback`, checkpoint: rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId, boundary: state.boundary };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const to = globalThis.__gate - 1; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugEpistemicResponse = `[knows] Arin | the ferryman takes no coin after dark`; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugLedgerResponse = `[state:Arin:character] condition=healthy`; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugSceneSummaryResponse = `NONE`; const wrote = await rt.runEpistemicLedgerPass({ id: `derived-1`, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: `scene:location`, contractHash: `derived`, scope: [], window: { from: 0, to }, prompt: ``, rawResponse: ``, acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [], sceneBreak: { at: to, reason: `location` } }); const belief = rt.getEpistemic().filter((entry) => entry.subject === `Arin` && !entry.supersededBy); const view = rt.getLedger().filter((row) => row.entity === `Arin`); if (!belief.length) throw new Error(`the reveal never landed (wrote=${wrote}): ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().memory.epistemic)}`); if (!view.some((row) => row.field === `condition` && row.value === `healthy`)) throw new Error(`the ledger never took the first value (wrote=${wrote}): ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().memory.ledger)}`); globalThis.__derivedBelief = belief[0].id; return { wrote, to, belief: belief[0].id, messageId: belief[0].messageId };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const active = rt.getEpistemic().filter((entry) => !entry.supersededBy); const index = active.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__derivedBelief) + 1; if (index < 1) throw new Error(`the belief is not in the pass's own numbered list: ${JSON.stringify(active.map((entry) => entry.id))}`); globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugEpistemicResponse = `[retire] ${index}`; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugLedgerResponse = `[state:Arin:character] condition=wounded`; const to = globalThis.__gate; const wrote = await rt.runEpistemicLedgerPass({ id: `derived-2`, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: `scene:location`, contractHash: `derived`, scope: [], window: { from: 0, to }, prompt: ``, rawResponse: ``, acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [], sceneBreak: { at: to, reason: `location` } }); const after = rt.getEpistemic().find((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__derivedBelief); const view = rt.getLedger().filter((row) => row.entity === `Arin` && row.field === `condition`); if (!after?.supersededBy) throw new Error(`the reveal never retired the belief (wrote=${wrote}): ${JSON.stringify(after)}`); if (!view.some((row) => row.value === `wounded`)) throw new Error(`the ledger never took the update (wrote=${wrote}): ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().memory.ledger)}`); return { wrote, to, retiredAt: after.retiredAt, view };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = globalThis.__gate; const message = ctx.chat?.[id]; if (!message || message.is_user) throw new Error(`the gate message ${id} is not a reply`); const text = `I stay by the door and leave the posting unread.`; message.mes = text; if (Array.isArray(message.swipes) && Number.isInteger(message.swipe_id)) message.swipes[message.swipe_id] = text; await ctx.updateMessageBlock?.(id, message); await ctx.saveChat?.(); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_EDITED, id); return { edited: id, newest: id === ctx.chat.length - 1 };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const view = rt.getLedger().filter((row) => row.entity === `Arin` && row.field === `condition`); const belief = rt.getEpistemic().find((entry) => entry.id === globalThis.__derivedBelief); const notice = rt.getSnapshot().lastRollback; if (!notice) throw new Error(`the edit did not roll the story back: ${JSON.stringify({ unavailable: rt.getSnapshot().rollbackUnavailable, checkpoint: rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId })}`); if (view.some((row) => row.value === `wounded`)) throw new Error(`the rolled-back update is still in the ledger: ${JSON.stringify(view)}`); if (!view.some((row) => row.value === `healthy`)) throw new Error(`the prior value did not return: ${JSON.stringify(view)}`); if (!belief) throw new Error(`the belief was dropped by the rollback instead of being un-retired: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().memory.epistemic)}`); if (belief.supersededBy) throw new Error(`the retirement survived the rollback: ${JSON.stringify(belief)}`); return { view, belief: belief.id, notice };
